glass-leaf.note: Rendered as --glass: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,.42), rgba(255,255,255,.16)) with blur(18px) saturate(1.8).

glass-strong.note: Sheets, dialogs, menus, toasts: rgba(246,248,252,.78), blur(30px). Night rgba(22,27,37,.82).

hero-figure.purpose: The station value on blue glass (40px on phones).

figure.purpose: Tile values, prices, KPIs, tank percentages.

shadows.name: glass-rim
shadows.purpose: Every glass surface: light caught on the top edge. Night .22 / .06.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Rise (0.8s, translateY 16px, scale .985, blur 6px), bars (0.9s), rings (1.4s), sheets.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Tiles rise one after the other; quick actions 0.1s after.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: The world behind the glass, only where hover: hover.

themes.light: chosen with the sun key, stored as localStorage theme-registre = 'light'

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one MTG-blue glass button of a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(18,108,200,.9),rgba(8,64,128,.94));color:#fff;font:700 15px/1.2 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(1.6);box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15),0 8px 20px rgba(11,111,196,.22);cursor:pointer}

components.name: Quick Action
components.description: Glass squircle with the glyph, the label beneath.
components.css: .ds-act{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:700 13px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;color:inherit}.ds-sq{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(255,255,255,.34),rgba(255,255,255,.06) 45%,rgba(255,255,255,.14));backdrop-filter:blur(6px) saturate(1.8) brightness(1.06);box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.95),inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 8px 20px rgba(20,40,80,.1);font-size:26px}

components.name: Hero
components.description: The station value on blue glass.
components.html:
Valeur de la station
12 480,00 $
components.css: .ds-hero{padding:22px 22px 24px;border-radius:24px;color:#fff;font-family:Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(20,110,200,.62),rgba(8,60,120,.72));backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(1.6);box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55),0 24px 50px rgba(10,40,90,.24)}.ds-hero .l{font:600 13px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;opacity:.82}.ds-hero .v{margin-top:8px;font:800 44px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Tile
components.description: A glanced figure of today, coloured by meaning.
components.css: .ds-tile{padding:15px 16px 16px;border-radius:20px;font-family:Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.42),rgba(255,255,255,.16));backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.8);box-shadow:inset 0 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.95),0 12px 30px rgba(20,40,80,.08)}.ds-tile .h{font-weight:700;color:#0f8f5c}.ds-tile .v{margin-top:12px;font:800 30px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-tile small{margin-left:3px;font-size:15px;opacity:.6}

narrative.overview: Clear liquid glass over a soft blurred world of colour, like Apple Wallet / Santé: sober, premium, few buttons, colour only where it means something. Night by default.
keyCharacteristics: A blurred world of colour behind everything
Clear glass panels, bars, sheets and buttons with a bright rim
The station value on MTG-blue glass
Arrivals rise out of a blur; figures count up; rings fill

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Colour is meaning: blue the main action and the value, fuel colours the fuels, red what is owed or lost, gold combos.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: One blue glass button per region; every other button is clear glass with ink text.

rules.name: The Clear Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass stays as transparent as it is (« plus transparent »); never an opaque page layer over the world.

dos: Use the glass tokens and keep the solid fallback
One blue glass button per region
Keep night and light in step
Equal-width grouped buttons, centred on mobile
donts: No coloured buttons beyond the one blue
No return to Registre or Totem de nuit
No Apple logo, name or imagery
